_metadata.purpose: Every owner decision applied on the consolidated-1022 import branch, replayed in order by scripts/unlimited/import-consolidated-owner.mjs after the import merge. Each decision is an owner override (human_approved) and, with prefer, a canonical preference by the owner. Replaced hints stay stored with their reviews; nothing is deleted.
_metadata.actions: add = catalogue.mjs add --by owner --approve [--prefer] (new hint; text from the owner's rationale); approve = existing hint becomes human_approved by the owner [and canonical with prefer], optional owner text via correct-text.mjs; hold = owner hold in rejections.json (never served for that pair)
_metadata.rounds: 2026-10-21 (owner chat after round 1), 2026-10-22 (review decisions after round 2), 2026-10-22 (final decisions before release)
